title: Aoyagi Toya — Taking On A New Challenge〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
And, there...
That's basically how you get it into the biggest cup.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see.
Kendama is about using your knees to cushion the ball's fall.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which is interesting, since those two things seemingly have nothing to do with one another. I doubt I would've ever arrived at this technique if you hadn't shown me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyway, this is it as far as useful tricks go.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay.
I'll try again using what you just showed me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Fling the ball straight into the air...
And use your knees to cushion it as it falls into the cup...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Aren't you gonna do it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: First, I need to visualize.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I won't succeed unless I can picture the flow of events for myself.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I don't think you need to go that far.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But it is like you to do this...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay, I have a clear picture.
Here it goes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, you were slightly off the cup.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Again...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, you were pretty close just now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Unfortunately, the image I formed in my head wasn't complete.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I need to keep in mind what you told me to do and...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I did it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Nice. You got it into the biggest cup.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I didn't think it would take me so few tries.
This is incredible...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Think you've got the hang of it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I believe so.
I'll try catching it in the two smaller cups next.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, here goes nothing.
A few minutes later

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hup...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Whoa.
You can already get it into the smallest cup.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm just as surprised as you are. I've never been very good at ball sports. I wasn't expecting to improve this quickly...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm not sure this counts as a ball sport.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I wouldn't have been able to do this without you, Akito. So, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
All I did was give you some advice.
You were the one who actually made it happen.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But your advice was incredibly helpful.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: All that remains is to land it on the prong, and then I'll be done. Would you mind showing me how to do that?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
To be honest, I'm not very good at that.
It usually takes me like ten tries to succeed.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. It must be very difficult if it gives even you that much trouble...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're supposed to use the same technique, more or less.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you need to fling the ball as straight into the air as you can in order to keep the hole steady. Once it's in the air, you move the prong underneath it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In other words, you have to move the whole object underneath this tiny hole...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That sounds difficult.
It's going to require quite a bit of hand-eye coordination...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, the ones who know what to do make it look easy, but it's not like it's totally impossible.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Right. I'll just have to believe in myself here.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Focus on the ball. Fling it straight up into the air...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Quickly... But smoothly, move the prong underneath...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright, here it goes...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hup!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I did it...! I did it, Akito! Did you see that?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa, that's awesome! You got it in one try!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
What an incredible feeling...!
My hands are shaking from all this exhilaration...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Haha. Calm down, dude.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Anyway, what was your trick?
Can you tell me how you did that just now?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I basically just followed your advice, but the most important thing was to...
